purpose: Non-admission source discovery for the official NRW LoD2 3D-building OGC API Features product, differentiated from restricted nationwide LoD2-DE and from NRW bulk CityGML delivery. Research-only technical access and source-vintage assessment for an explicitly fictional German exposure pilot.

entries.name: North Rhine-Westphalia official LoD2 3D buildings OGC API Features (2026)
entries.spatial_scope: North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany; coverage and geometry at exact API feature/query level still require a bounded source probe
entries.temporal_scope: Official OGC API Features metadata revision 2026-09-08; LoD2 source metadata references ALS and DGM1 2019-2025, ALKIS building footprints dated 2025-07-01, and ATKIS geometry dated 2025-10-01. Not a 2021 or any other historical event-year snapshot.
entries.resolution_or_granularity: Individual modelled buildings and structures with standardized LoD2 roof forms; official OGC API Features delivery lists CityJSON, CityGML, glTF and 3D Tiles. Separate bulk CityGML downloads exist; format/field support and entity counts for any selected collection require live schema inspection.
entries.access_class_hint: Publisher metadata: public OGC API Features https://ogc-api.nrw.de/3dg/v1 with no dataset access restrictions, source licence Datenlizenz Deutschland Zero 2.0; exact live API query behavior, rate/automation policy and selected asset identity not yet reviewed
entries.note: Provider/AdV catalogue describes OGC API Features and data origin; original CityGML and SLPK are separate delivery products. See official metadata https://www.distributions.informationgrid.eu/trefferanzeige?docuuid=bde30228-a718-45a8-9518-1e17e47c0187. Before any acquisition, pin exact collection, request, response version, CRS, feature identifiers, authoritative terms and any API-service conditions, then sample a very small original feature window outside Git with SHA-256 evidence. Roof geometry or ALKIS location does not identify an R+V-insured building, construction quality, 2021 event-time exposure, replacement cost, contract terms, damage or loss. Do not equate a fictional NRW policy cohort with actual NRW insurer locations or publish data bytes merely because publisher metadata cites DL-DE/Zero-2.0.
